The [intro slides](welcome.qmd), shown in the welcome slot on Day 1, give the setup and this schedule in short form.

Day 1 keeps the shorter modules because its briefings are the lightest. From Day 2, each briefing has room for its predictions, checks and demo, and each lab ends with a debrief: what the room found, and where results differed. Those days open with a warm-up, a few knowledge check questions from earlier days, and close with a wrap-up: the day's results go into a running table, and the room names the limitation that is left.

[Module 0 · {{< var modules.m00.title >}}](modules/00-coding-agents.qmd) is optional pre-work, done on your own laptop before Day 1. There is no talk and no notebook. If you get stuck, the room opens at 08:00 on Day 1 for an optional drop-in clinic. The workshop proper starts at 09:00.
